title: Neural networks for spectral optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.36047v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Given a functional dependent on the spectrum of a differential operator, we address the problem of finding a domain which optimizes this functional. PDE solvers might be used to tackle this optimization. It is however computationally expensive. We propose two neural network models which learn the spectrum directly from the geometry of the domain and can be used to optimize the domain from one or more eigenvalues. We investigate two representations. The first encodes the domain through Fourier coefficients and a light MLP, which is efficient on star-shaped geometries, achieving a precision of 0.2\%. Through a rescaling of the coefficients the designed models satisfy the scaling law of the eigenvalues. Additionally, averaging the outputs of the trained surrogates over rotations and reflections induces invariance for these transformations. translated_title: 面向谱优化的神经网络
translated_abstract: 给定一个依赖于微分算子谱的泛函，我们研究寻找能够优化该泛函的区域这一数学问题。虽然可以使用偏微分方程（PDE）求解器来解决该优化问题，但其计算代价十分高昂。我们提出了两个神经网络模型，它们能够直接从区域的几何形状学习谱信息，并可用于基于一个或多个特征值来优化区域形状。我们研究了两种表示方法：第一种通过傅里叶系数和一个轻量级多层感知机（MLP）对区域进行编码，该方法在星形几何上表现出色，达到了0.2%的精度。通过对系数进行重新缩放，所设计的模型满足特征值的标度律；此外，将训练好的代理模型在旋转和反射变换下的输出取平均，可使模型对这些变换具有不变性。第二种模型则采用地形函数、指示函数及其梯度（原文摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出两种直接从区域几何学习微分算子谱的神经网络模型，用以替代昂贵的PDE求解器进行谱泛函优化，其中基于傅里叶系数与轻量级MLP的方法在星形几何上达到0.2%的精度，并满足特征值标度律和对称不变性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two neural network models that learn operator spectra directly from domain geometry to replace costly PDE solvers in spectral functional optimization, with a Fourier-coefficient and lightweight MLP approach achieving 0.2% precision on star-shaped geometries while satisfying eigenvalue scaling laws and symmetry invariances.
